title: Two next experiments for the condensate food chain where both kinds divide: (a) the predator's division at the default lineage window (handling time / satiation so that predator droplets live > 2000 t), (b) E that is not by construction (prey whose condensed state, not their matter, needs the fuel)
summary: In 20261026T1302-c42-foodchain-both-divide-claim prey and predator condensates both divide from noise and coexist, but predator daughters live only ~500-1500 t (persistent splits 0 at K=20, 30-34 at K=5), and E holds by construction (prey built only from fuel, predators only from prey). (a) Give predators a handling time: eat = k2 ca cb^2 / (1 + h k2 ca) with h 5-50 (the world's Ksat is the same form), or a slower predator decay kq 0.002 with Du 1, and ask whether predator droplets then live >= 2000 t between ring fragmentations and reach generation >= 2 at labkit's default K=20 on 3 seeds (128^2, t=12000, about 3 min each at OMP 1). (b) Replace the prey's build-from-fuel by a conserved prey material that only condenses while it turns fuel over (c40's CIPS) but is robust to distributed loss; 20261026T1333-c42-cips-predator-negative shows c40's CIPS bodies dissolve under any bath loss, so the predator there must be planted as condensates or the prey bath must be supercritical.
experiment: (a) world.py of 20261026T1302-c42-foodchain-both-divide-claim with WORLD_P {"Ksat": 0.05-0.5} or {"kq": 0.002}; labkit --seeds 0 1 2 --size 128 128 --frames 120 --no-movie (default K) and --lineage-k 5; report predator persistent splits, generation, merge/split and the predator-free twin (pred_on 0).
